[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd tags

# Tags set only in GOFLAGS reach the monitored build.
env GOFLAGS=-tags=foo
logos conc run .
stdout '^foo$'

# An explicit -tags overrides GOFLAGS, and the monitor joins it.
logos conc run -tags=bar .
stdout '^plain$'

# The plain command agrees with the monitored build.
logos run .
stdout '^foo$'
logos run -tags=bar .
stdout '^plain$'

-- tags/go.mod --
module example.com/tags

go 1.27
-- tags/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(variant)
}
-- tags/variant_plain.go --
//go:build !foo

package main

const variant = "plain"
-- tags/variant_foo.go --
//go:build foo

package main

const variant = "foo"
